title: Skip link activates but focus is left on <body>; <main> is not programmatically focusable [2.4.1 Bypass Blocks]
steps: Press Tab once (skip link shows, with visible focus)
expected: Focus moves to main (tabindex=-1) so the next Tab lands in page content in all browsers.
actual: URL gets #main but document.activeElement is BODY. Works in Chrome via the sequential-focus start point, but Safari/older browsers may restart at the top. Skip link visibility and focus ring are good.
evidence: Playwright: after Enter activeElement BODY, hash #main
